text_block_list.text: —The 'Spring Fan Appreciation Festival'.

It's a day to show gratitude for their 
everyday support by inviting fans to the 
academy and letting them enjoy sports 
events featuring the Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, it's about to begin!! The fierce 
Variety Survival Raaaceeee!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Gathered here today are the trendiest 
Umamusume running at the absolute 
forefront of the racing scene!!
(WOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'm in your hands today, Journey-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yes, the pleasure is mine.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Still, I gotta say, I'm surprised~ I 
didn't think you'd enter an event that 
feels so much like a variety show, Senpai.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Listen here. Upperclassmen are free to 
enter whatever events they want. That's 
just prejudice, you know.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Well, I certainly won't deny it's 
rare. However—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I'll be giving it my absolute best 
today... So let's both do our best, 
Vodka-san, Scarlet-san.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes! I look forward to working with 
you!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...How very convenient.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Race 1 is the 'Don't Take the Plunge 
Steeplechase'! Touching the elimination 
zone near the obstacles means instant 
disqualification!! It demands both caution 
and daring!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Balance beams, swinging platforms... Make 
one mistake on any obstacle, and you're 
headed straight to the elimination zone, 
huh.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I want to take the lead first, but to win, 
I need to be cautious here...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
At a time like this, it's all about 
guts...! I'm gonna blow past 'em all...!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
All Umamusume, to your marks!! Ready... 
GOOO!!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Wha...—?! Senpai took the lead?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? Taking the lead with a rocket start 
is Dream Journey!! A daring move 
completely different from her usual racing 
style!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Dream Journey fearlessly takes on the 
obstacles! Undaunted!! And incredibly 
fast!!

text_block_list.name: Journey Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! Seeing Dream Journey run on a 
balance beam is pretty fresh...! Keep it 
up! You got this--!!

text_block_list.name: Journey Fan B
text_block_list.text:
So this is what Dream Journey is like 
outside of the Twinkle Series...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Dream Journey crosses the finish line, 
miraculously holding on to the lead!! An 
absolute upset right from Race 1~~!!
(WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fumu...――

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: —Aaargh! They got me!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You're amazing, Senpai! Just when I 
thought you were shaken from losing the 
lead, you smoothly pulled ahead just like 
that!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I figured if I played it straight, I 
wouldn't stand a chance against all of 
you.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"First, catch them off guard. After that, 
make full use of a small frame... 
something like that."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Th-The brainy type, so cool...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I mean, Journey-senpai... ran like she 
already had the entire course memorized in 
her head, didn't she...?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
......I had plenty of time to watch it 
before the start, after all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I-I see...

Even after that, the variety survival race 
continued on—

—Race 3, the "Sparking Brains Buzzer Quiz 
Race".

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Correct!!! T-That was way too fast--!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ngh...! I'm one move behind...!!

text_block_list.name: Journey Fan C
text_block_list.text:
N-ngh... So cool and intellectual... I'm 
totally stanning her...!

—Race 7, the "Heart-Piercing Signature 
Pose Race".

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Alright! I'll show off the secret 
weapon I came up with Gin-senpai right 
here...!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: —Ignition.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Let's shift gears and kick it up.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: —Just shut up and follow me.
(WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah, that nailed it~~!! Gim-senpai, 
seriously, tysm...!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Going first, Vodka! With a totally cool 
delivery, the crowd goes wild!! How will 
the second act respond!?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Well then—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, what a naughty child.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Seems like... someone needs to be 
punished.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Now—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —Kneel before me.
(KYAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A-An unexpected angle! A stark contrast to 
her usual gentle self, she's radiating 
sheer aggression and the aura of a master! 
The venue is positively shaking with 
excitement--!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: W-Why is my heart pounding too~~?!

text_block_list.name: Journey Fan D
text_block_list.text: Haaah... Journey-sama...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And with that, all races are officially 
concluded!! The overall points champion 
is—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
With an outstanding performance across all 
races, it's Dream Journeyyy!!
(WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Y-You got me good... Who knew you were so 
talented, Senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Guess I was the one harboring prejudices 
after all—

text_block_list.name: Journey Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Man, my impression of Dream Journey 
changed in a really good way. She's 
actually super down to go with the 
flow...!"

text_block_list.name: Journey Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I got to see so many different sides of 
Dream Journey, it was amazing...! I think 
I might like her even more now—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, someone who can keep up with us. 
This level of variety won't be a problem 
for them at all—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Man, I can't stop acting like a proud big 
sister in the back! Let's hold a 
behind-the-scenes variety race later to 
decide who the true living-room Umamusume 
is!

Afterward, time was set aside for a 
meet-and-greet between the spectating fans 
and participating Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Journey Fan E
text_block_list.text:
Um, congratulations on your victory...! It 
was so much fun seeing you shine in so 
many ways today, Dream Journey-san!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...I am honored to hear you say that.

text_block_list.name: Journey Fan E
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep cheering for you, Dream 
Journey-san! Good luck in your races, too!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Thank you—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: …………Um. May I ask you a question?

text_block_list.name: Journey Fan E
text_block_list.text: Huh!? W-Well, of course—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"What was it you saw in me that made you 
think... you wanted to support me?"

text_block_list.name: Journey Fan E
text_block_list.text:
"‘I want to cheer them on’... um, thinking 
that was—"

text_block_list.name: Journey Fan E
text_block_list.text:
I... I really love the look in Dream 
Journey's eyes after she finishes a race.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Eyes, did you say?

text_block_list.name: Journey Fan E
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It's as if they're gazing far into 
the distance, almost pulling you in...

text_block_list.name: Journey Fan E
text_block_list.text:
I became so curious about what she was 
aiming for, and where she was trying to 
go.

text_block_list.name: Journey Fan E
text_block_list.text:
And so, they've been following your 
races... and I'm sure they're still 
cheering you on even now.

text_block_list.name: Journey Fan E
text_block_list.text:
I just want to know... how far you can 
go...!

text_block_list.name: Journey Fan E
text_block_list.text:
...Aah! I'm saying weird things, aren't 
I?! Did I totally creep you out!?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ......Smiling again—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(Ane-go... you truly are a wondrous 
person... Always gazing into the distance 
with a joyful look—)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...I'd like to see it.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: (Just how far you will go—)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—It's not weird at all. I'm... truly 
delighted.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
As a small token of thanks for your 
question, might I have a moment of your 
time?

text_block_list.name: Journey Fan E
text_block_list.text: Huh—— I-Is this a portrait of me!?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Pardon the rough sketch, but please take 
it as a souvenir if you like.

text_block_list.name: Journey Fan E
text_block_list.text:
Sloppy?! Not at all, it's incredible...! 
To make something so lifelike in such a 
short time...!!

text_block_list.name: Journey Fan E
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much!! I'll make it a family 
heirloom!!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Please continue to support me going 
forward. I will surely take you along with 
me."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...All the way to the far reaches of my 
gaze.

And so, Dream Journey concluded the Fan 
Appreciation Festival with great success—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Just as you said, Trainer, it really 
was the right choice to face the fans 
today.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yes. ...This change in my heart.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Just as Big Sis once did... From now on, 
I want to focus on running in a way that 
answers the fans' cheers."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"By doing that, I'm sure... I'll be able 
to reach it too—"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—For now, our immediate focus is the Tenno 
Sho (Spring). Let us approach it with a 
fresh mindset.

"Sensing both the arrival of spring and 
the changes within herself, the traveler 
journeys on—"

text_block_list.name: Journey's Fans
text_block_list.text: (Murmur, murmur, murmur, murmur...!)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my— Could it be that you all desire my 
painting as well?"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. If so, I shall make them 
for everyone here as well. Fortunately, I 
write rather quickly.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Just, in exchange... please tell me more 
of your stories.

And so, surrounded by a multitude of fans, 
Dream Journey wrapped up the Fan 
Appreciation Festival in glorious fashion—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Just as you said, Trainer, it really 
was the right choice to face the fans 
today.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yes. ...This change in my heart.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Just as Big Sis once did... From now on, 
I want to focus on running in a way that 
answers the fans' cheers."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"By doing that, I'm sure... I'll be able 
to reach it too—"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—For now, our immediate focus is the Tenno 
Sho (Spring). Let us approach it with a 
fresh mindset.

"...Still, she really did an amazing job 
today. Not just in the variety race, but—"

...I didn't know you were so good at 
drawing.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...I only do quick pencil sketches. I 
don't use other art supplies or colors."

Do you have a particular preference?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't call it a major preference— but 
it's quick, easy, and black just looks 
great.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Because with every black line drawn, 
all kinds of things begin to surface.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right. Since this is a good 
opportunity, may I draw a portrait of you, 
Trainer?
choice_data_list:

Huh? Are you sure you're okay with drawing 
it for me?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu— ...Of course.

...And the portrait that Dream Journey 
drew for me turned out to have a truly 
atmospheric quality—

I decided to preserve it carefully, 
feeling that I'd like to look back on it 
every now and then as a memory of today—

"Sensing both the arrival of spring and 
the changes within herself, the traveler 
journeys on—"
